body:
Currently it's not possible to implement a Hierarchical Menu with multiple selections within a custom widget. We use a library internally called the [Helper](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js) to manage hierarchical facets. This lib does not support multiple refinement for the hierarchical facet. It's something that we have on our roadmap but we don't have any other precision.

For the moment the only solution is to look at how the Helper manage the hierarchical facets. From that you can create a version that supports multiple selections. Unfortunately this is the only solution we have. I'll close this issue since it's already tracked #1658 .
